english.note: Use this all-purpose construction when movement, balance, a voice, or another performance starts to become unsteady.

examples.english: When they got nervous, their voice began to falter and started trembling.
examples.traditional: 佢一緊張，講嘢開始唔穩，成把聲都震晒。
